correctness.rationale: Random-priority/memoryless available-set equivalence is exact; first two acceptances split into antipode, distance-two and distance-three orbits with probabilities 1/11, 6/11, 4/11. The respective induced graphs are six isolated points, a square with four opposing pendant leaves, and a six-cycle. Explicit conditional rational calculations yield the three stated probabilities, independently matched by exact memoized eligible-set recurrence and exact independent-set-state Markov propagation. A parity/Hamming-distance argument exhausts terminal 4/5/8-site families, with 24/16/2 sets; independent 384-automorphism calculation confirms individual orbit masses.

value.rationale: The natural small finite Hamming lattice Q4 is a canonical degree-four substrate for hard-core sequential monomer adsorption. A complete exact terminal law distinguishes kinetic sampling from uniform maximal configurations: maximally occupied states have probability 49/110, over nine times their uniform-maximal-set frequency 1/21, and capacities six and seven are unattainable at jamming. These exact constants and orbit probabilities are useful as transparent reproducible benchmarks for approximate jamming calculations, not merely a trivial relabeling of a known table.
